SELECT
  l.id,
  s.name AS station_name,
  s.id AS station_code,
  l.called_at,
  l.fetched_at,
  l.status,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (l.fetched_at - l.called_at)) AS duration_sec
FROM api_fetch_logs l
JOIN stations s ON s.id = l.station_id
WHERE
  (
    '{{ stateSearchText.value || "" }}' = ''
    OR s.name ILIKE '%{{ stateSearchText.value || "" }}%'
  )
  AND (
    '{{ stateStatusFilter.value || "all" }}' = 'all'
    OR l.status = '{{ stateStatusFilter.value || "all" }}'
  )
ORDER BY l.called_at DESC
LIMIT 20
OFFSET (({{ stateCurrentPage.value || 1 }} - 1) * 20);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
FROM api_fetch_logs l
JOIN stations s ON s.id = l.station_id
WHERE
  (
    '{{ stateSearchText.value || "" }}' = ''
    OR s.name ILIKE '%{{ stateSearchText.value || "" }}%'
  )
  AND (
    '{{ stateStatusFilter.value || "all" }}' = 'all'
    OR l.status = '{{ stateStatusFilter.value || "all" }}'
  );

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE called_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') AS total_24h,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE called_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND status = 'success') AS success_24h,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE called_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND status = 'failed') AS failed_24h,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pollution_readings) AS total_records
FROM api_fetch_logs;

SELECT
  s.id, s.name, s.city, s.state,
  latest_log.status AS last_status,
  latest_log.called_at AS last_called,
  latest_reading.aqius AS current_aqi
FROM stations s
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT status, called_at FROM api_fetch_logs l
  WHERE l.station_id = s.id ORDER BY l.called_at DESC LIMIT 1
) latest_log ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT aqius FROM pollution_readings p
  WHERE p.station_id = s.id ORDER BY p.ts DESC LIMIT 1
) latest_reading ON true
ORDER BY s.id
LIMIT 15;

SELECT
  l.id,
  s.name AS station_name,
  s.id AS station_code,
  l.called_at,
  l.fetched_at,
  l.status,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (l.fetched_at - l.called_at)) AS duration_sec
FROM api_fetch_logs l
JOIN stations s ON s.id = l.station_id
WHERE l.status = '{{ stateModalStatus.value }}'
ORDER BY l.called_at DESC
LIMIT 5
OFFSET (({{ stateModalPage.value || 1 }} - 1) * 5);
